title: Penalty not awarded: handball appeal against Richards
summary: Penalty not awarded: Handball appeal against Richards. Panel: The Referee's call of no penalty for a potential handball offence against Richards was supported. The ball deflected off his own body changing trajectory before making contact with his arm.
